title: office.recall request

question.description: Literal case-insensitive whitespace-separated terms; all terms match across entry text, session title, session id and stored refs. Absent or null selects feed mode: every entry, newest first. No model call.

session_id.description: Exact engine session identity; only that session's conversation source contributes. Filters both question and feed mode.

since.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (UTC start of day).

until.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD (UTC end of day).

limit.description: Maximum matching public or private entries contributing to this result: 1–50 with a question, 1–200 in feed mode.

description: With a question: a literal search, limit 1–50. Without one (feed mode): entries newest first, limit 1–200, typically scoped to one session_id for the Scribe window feed.
